sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, a floating-rate loan granted for purposes other than business to an individual and sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 must not have pre-payment charges levied. [E7, R4]
So the question’s assumption that the bank can charge a pre-payment penalty for this case is not supported by the in-force directions. [E7, R4]
The older directions on floating-rate term loans and the 2025 directions were later withdrawn or superseded and are not in force on 2026-11-23. [R1, R2, E12, E14]

missing.searched: Searched the in-force pre-payment charge directions for a rate applicable to floating-rate home loans to individuals sanctioned in 2026 for a Tier 3 UCB; the cited directions say no pre-payment charges may be levied, so no rate is provided.
